name: Bleeding Walls (CR 5)
body:
Bleeding Walls
CR 5

XP 1,600
CE haunt (5 ft. by 20 ft. hallway)
Caster Level 5th
Notice Perception DC 20 (to hear the sound of soft sobbing)
hp 10; Trigger proximity; Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, thick rivulets of blood course down the walls accompanied by the shrill shriek of a woman’s scream. All creatures in the area are targeted by a fear spell (Will DC 16).

DESTRUCTION

The body of the maid entombed behind the walls must be extracted and given a proper burial.
